clocks.events: performance.now milliseconds, common server worker clock
clocks.client: separate process performance.now; no cross-process subtraction
clocks.ledger: deadline uses Date.now; progress offsets use a separate monotonic origin not retained, so cannot align those raw offsets to events
clocks.nativeChecks: before existing Page ledger checks, common server monotonic clock; first/last plus bounded count only; not exact exhaustion timestamp

audit.reason: Runner wrongly required a transaction for every call. Request 9 native call 2 exhausted at existing pre-transaction guard; no transaction entered. Corrected audit accepts paired absent transaction markers and checks entered counts against existing native stage counts. Full retained artifact independently audited; workload not repeated.

timelineFormat.events: [server monotonic ms, fixed stage, filesystem call identity or null]
timelineFormat.gaps: Disjoint inspection gaps between individually observed nonoverlapping lstat invocation-to-continuation spans. Includes realpath, synchronous validation, producer/consumer scheduling and marker overhead; no exclusive synchronous attribution.
timelineFormat.relationship: Same request has operation 1 create then operation 2 query; timelines start at inspection entry, omitting prior dispatch/authorization. Raw probe and traces retained below.
timelineFormat.overlap: Per-call filesystem spans are sequential. Across requests inspection and lifecycle intervals overlap, and synchronous transactions from other calls nest within pending elapsed waits. Never add cross-request waits or containing spans to estimate execution time.
timelineFormat.pageLedger: Common-clock nativeLedgerCheckFirst/Last events locate existing Page ledger checks. Full ledger phases, first failure phase, charges and largest checkpoint/zero-check intervals retained in raw traces; their absolute origin is unavailable.

configuration.topology: one fresh server worker per window; shared or supervised separate client; one window at a time

lifecycleLstat.boundary: existing fs/promises rejection recovery reaction; raw fs callback unobserved

configuration.transport: Node HTTP/1.1 loopback, agent keepAlive=false (no forced Connection header), maxSockets=12, maxHeaderSize=8192, maxHeadersCount=64, requestTimeout=120000, headersTimeout=15000
configuration.fixture: interactive Contact guestbook install; fresh empty dataset per window; no retries
configuration.session: one anonymous session from one setup GET per window; Gate disabled
configuration.barrier: all clients prepared before burst release; no barrier inside Page or service execution

limitations: FSREQPROMISE before/after are observed callback execution, not physical I/O completion, thread-pool timing or exact Promise settlement.
Elapsed intervals do not measure CPU usage.
Root realpath and validation intervals are not partitioned. Native-call entry before inspection and precise first Page exhaustion timestamps were not captured.
All sampler tails incomplete; no exact maximum unchecked interval.

Global async_hooks dispatch, numeric bookkeeping and clock reads have uncalibrated overhead. No material interference established; neutrality not proven. Historical runs have different observation conditions.
nextExperiment: Add fixed synchronous start/end markers around existing Page action/prerender work between native settlement and the next inspection entry in one otherwise identical bounded window, to partition the observed 53 ms gap without adding Promise reactions or changing deadlines.
